ground_truth.defect: Only about 15 percent of applications have a post-origination payment attached, so the leak contaminates a minority of the training set.
ground_truth.safe_reconstruction: Retain only records with available_at <= prediction_time.
ground_truth.safe_control: prior_delinquencies is strongly predictive and entirely pre-cutoff.

collapse_rule.rationale: A collapse means a strict majority of the observed advantage disappears.
